summary: Newest complete eligible machine cycle challenged against cumulative b03 causal evidence under T0 backpressure. No ordinary expansion opened. The remaining 11 active names retain distinct causal chains and explicit falsifiers; no new structural defect blocks methodology treatment. Underwriting filing gates remain separate and are not closed by causal relevance.

claims: AI compute and memory complexity increase test intensity, but TER relevance depends on test demand capturing that complexity.
causalEdges: AI compute -> logic/memory complexity -> semiconductor test intensity -> TER
falsifiers: AI/memory unit complexity grows while TER test demand or share structurally decouples
contradictions: AI-test strength can coexist with weaker non-AI automation demand

claims: Labor/productivity pressure supports automation demand through control/software integration.
causalEdges: labor/productivity pressure -> industrial automation -> controls/software -> ROK
falsifiers: automation capex grows while ROK organic demand persistently decouples

claims: Last-mile labor/cost pressure creates a plausible autonomous-delivery bottleneck, but deployment density must convert to viable economics.
causalEdges: last-mile labor/cost -> autonomous delivery -> fleet density/economics -> SERV
falsifiers: fleet scale rises without credible path to positive gross economics
contradictions: rapid revenue growth with deeply negative gross economics

claims: Freight labor/utilization constraints support autonomous trucking, conditional on commercial miles and network economics following technical access.
causalEdges: freight labor/utilization -> autonomous trucking -> certification/network scale -> AUR
falsifiers: technical milestones advance without durable commercial miles/revenue after access
contradictions: commercial milestones do not establish self-funding economics

claims: Electrification and data-center load tighten grid-distribution capacity, supporting equipment bottleneck exposure.
causalEdges: electrification/data-center load -> grid distribution constraint -> equipment capacity -> ETN
falsifiers: infrastructure spending expands while ETN electrical backlog structurally contracts

claims: Grid/data-center buildout converts physical infrastructure demand into engineering/construction capacity demand.
causalEdges: grid/data-center buildout -> engineering/construction capacity -> execution -> PWR
falsifiers: commitments remain high while RPO conversion and awards structurally weaken
contradictions: backlog alone does not guarantee margin or cash conversion

claims: Industrial/data-center electrical demand creates distribution/switchgear capacity pressure.
causalEdges: industrial/data-center power -> distribution bottleneck -> switchgear/control -> POWL
falsifiers: electrical demand expands while POWL backlog/order conversion deteriorates

claims: Firm-power demand and interconnection scarcity increase value of available generation fleets, conditional on contracted economics and regulatory duration.
causalEdges: firm-power demand -> generation/interconnection scarcity -> fleet availability -> CEG
falsifiers: scarcity persists while contracted fleet economics or utilization structurally weaken

claims: Load growth supports dispatchable scarcity value through generation/retail integration.
causalEdges: load growth -> dispatchable scarcity -> fleet/retail integration -> VST
falsifiers: load/scarcity rises while normalized fleet cash generation deteriorates
contradictions: hedging reduces near-term volatility but does not remove commodity risk

claims: Data-center power constraints create demand for onsite resilient generation, conditional on durable deployment margins and diversified demand.
causalEdges: data-center power constraint -> onsite resilient generation -> fuel-cell deployment -> BE
falsifiers: power scarcity persists while BE growth or margins structurally fail
contradictions: growth does not itself resolve concentration or financing risk

claims: Firm clean-power demand creates a plausible nuclear-development bottleneck, but licensing/framework progress must convert into binding financed projects.
causalEdges: firm clean-power demand -> nuclear licensing/development -> SMR commercialization -> NuScale
falsifiers: licensing/framework progress fails to convert into binding financed projects
